# Task Template

Use this prompt text to start a structured request:

Goal:
- <what outcome you need>

Scope:
- Include: <files or modules>
- Exclude: <areas not to change>

Acceptance Criteria:
- <observable behavior>
- <test expectation>

Constraints:
- Follow .github/copilot-instructions.md
- Keep minimal diff
- Run lint, test, build

Output:
- Implementation summary
- Changed files
- Validation results
- Risks
